state.background: Review the current Plan39 nominal V2 provisional 2+ household-share correction, Other-share jump threshold rule, documentation/artifact synchronization, and direct type fixes required for the production build. Historical estimates through 2016 preserve per-category 2017 A/B anchor baselines, then add category-specific endpoint slopes gamma[c]=(A2025[c]-base2025[c])/(piJan2025-piJan2017), applied as base[t,c]+gamma[c]*(piIV4[t]-piIV4[2017]). Other is residual total minus nine majors when not published; total is the corrected category sum. Official A inputs from 2017 onward pass through. Runtime uses saved nominal A/B JSON at one-decimal precision. The dedicated production-pi2plus artifact and manifest verify source hashes and year/status coverage; 2011 is explicitly marked synthetic_interpolation_unverified. The historical IV-4 and January setai-n definitions differ, so historical pi is centered on its own 2017 value as a provisional source bridge. The Other-share threshold uses the maximum absolute adjacent annual change in official adjusted A Other/total shares from 2017 through 2025; effective threshold is dynamically rounded upward by ceil(rawMaximum*100)/100 to hundredths of a percentage point while both raw and effective values are retained.
acceptanceCriteria: The endpoint household-share correction preserves 2017 anchor values, uses per-category 2025 residual calibration, includes Other consistently, reconciles category slopes and total within floating-point tolerance, and fails closed on missing or invalid required shares and corrected values.

Official adjusted annual inputs from 2017 onward remain unchanged; the production A/B values use their saved one-decimal precision, and the separate raw-workbook research estimates are not substituted.

The production pi2plus artifact is manifest- and hash-validated, records source/vintage limitations, and identifies 2011 as a synthetic interpolated value; the result exposes provenance and year quality flags.

The Other-share threshold is derived dynamically from official A annual share jumps, rounds upward to the next 0.01 percentage point, and records the unrounded maximum, effective threshold, unit, and rule.
The input-matched analysis and OpenSpec/README state the model, retrospective calibration limitation, boundary result, and current publication-gate state consistently.
The production build completes successfully; no tests are required in this review scope.
